card.name: Linking words before a name or polymer
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'by', 'such as' or 'father/son' that come right before a proper name in Greek myth or epic stories. Also 'such as' before polymer names like polyethylene.

modes.label: Greek myth links
